decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that captures the shared background, header-logo, and optional-footer treatment for informational pages.
The source changes the separate account-provisioning page treatment and does not alter the dashboard console shell styling requirement.
The candidate already records the same-message footer content update, while optional use of that footer on the provisioning page does not change the footer's own specification.
Using a background derived from the landing page for the provisioning page does not change the landing page's visual design.
Removal of provisioning-wizard orientation guidance does not alter the independently established responsive behavior for the landing page and general website layouts.
Requiring a header logo on the provisioning page does not reintroduce or otherwise change website header navigation.
The simplified provisioning-page treatment does not change the landing-page implementation stack or handoff objective.
